**q25.** CEL (google/cel-go) — `internal/filter` (env/schema `internal/filter/schema.go:232`, entry `filter.DefaultEngine()` `internal/filter/engine.go:111`). The expression is parsed with CEL and validated against the memo schema, normalized into a dialect-agnostic IR (`internal/filter/ir.go`, `parser.go`), then rendered to a dialect-specific SQL fragment + args by `internal/filter/render.go`, which each driver appends to its WHERE clause via `filter.AppendConditions` with `DialectSQLite` / `DialectPostgres` / `DialectMySQL` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`); the API pre-validates it at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:211` → `shortcut_service.go:336`.

**q26.** `memo_relation` (both directions, `store/memo.go:142,145`), `attachment` (`store/memo.go:149-157`), `memo` (`store/memo.go:158`, plus comment memo rows deleted in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:568-576`), and `memo_share` via `FOREIGN KEY … ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:108`; declared for SQLite too at `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:108` but not enforced because SQLite opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)`, `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`). `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but not deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:544`).

**q27.** Go `embed.FS` of the built `dist/` bundle, served by Echo static handler with SPA fallback — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (`//go:embed dist/*`), wired at `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:41` (`Serve`) from `server/server.go:69`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go) — RunOnce at startup + time.Ticker every 12h (server/server.go:162-170; runner.go:26,30)
internal/webhook async dispatch workers (4 goroutines) — package init(), consume the PostAsync queue (internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54)
SSEHub — event-driven only (no timer); started implicitly with APIV1Service (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:56)
```
Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (full cron/job scheduler with README) is referenced only by its own tests — no production code imports it. `server/runner/memopayload`'s `Runner`/`RunOnce` is never started either; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:156` (attached to the transport at `:188`). Tokens: a short-lived JWT access token kept in `localStorage`/memory and sent as `Authorization: Bearer` (`web/src/auth-state.ts`, `connect.ts:142`), plus an httpOnly refresh-token cookie sent via `credentials: "include"` (`connect.ts:53-58`) and exchanged through `AuthService.RefreshToken` (`connect.ts:71-80`); backend also accepts Personal Access Tokens. Backend validation: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go:41` access token, `:61` refresh token, `:102` PAT), invoked from `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` via the gateway middleware (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:69`) and the Connect `NewAuthInterceptor` (`server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`).

The first three converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:48`); all four (including the comment one) converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` and `:120`.
